en: Genesis 5

p.src: 1  This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.
u.src: 1  This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

p.src: 2  He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

ja: らを祝福された。彼らが創
された日、神は彼らを人と名付けられた。
en: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
u.src: 2  He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

ja: 5:2 「アダム」と「人」は、ヘブライ語で同じ語である。
en: 5:2 “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way.

p.src: 3  Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

ja: た、彼のかたちどおりの男の
の父となり、その子をセツと名付けた。
en: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
u.src: 3  Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

p.src: 4  The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

ja: セツの父となって後、アダムは
en: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
u.src: 4  The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 5  All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

en: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.
u.src: 5  All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

p.src: 6  Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

ja: 年生きて、エノスの父となった。
en: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
u.src: 6  Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

p.src: 7  Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

ja: エノスの父となって後、セツは
en: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
u.src: 7  Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 8  All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

ja: こうして、セツの全生涯は
en: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.
u.src: 8  All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

p.src: 9  Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

ja: 年生きて、ケナンの父となった。
en: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
u.src: 9  Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

p.src: 10  Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

ja: ケナンの父となって後、エノスは
en: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
u.src: 10  Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 11  All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

ja: こうして、エノスの全生涯は
en: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.
u.src: 11  All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

p.src: 12  Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

ja: 年生きて、マハラレルの父となった。
en: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.
u.src: 12  Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

p.src: 13  Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

ja: マハラレルの父となって
en: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters
u.src: 13  Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

en: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
u.src: 14  and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

p.src: 15  Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

ja: 年生きて、ヤレドの父となった。
en: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
u.src: 15  Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

p.src: 16  Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 18  Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

ja: 年生きて、エノクの父となった。
en: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
u.src: 18  Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

en: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

p.src: 21  Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

ja: 年生きて、メトセラの父となった。
en: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.
u.src: 21  Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

p.src: 22  After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

ja: メトセラの父となって後、エノクは
en: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
u.src: 22  After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

en: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.
u.src: 23  All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

p.src: 24  Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

ja: んだ。そして、いなくなった。
en: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.
u.src: 24  Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

p.src: 25  Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

ja: 年生きて、レメクの父となった。
en: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.
u.src: 25  Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

p.src: 26  Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

en: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 27  All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

ja: こうして、メトセラの全
en: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.
u.src: 27  All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

p.src: 28  Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

en: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.
u.src: 28  Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

p.src: 29  He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

en: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”
u.src: 29  He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

ja: ノアの父となって後、レメクは
en: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
u.src: 30  Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

p.src: 31  All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

en: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.
u.src: 31  All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

p.src: 32  Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

ja: になり、セム、ハム、ヤペテの父となった。
en: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
